svg.text: Phase 2 · step 7g · Requirements, bundles, copying a schedule, and the Maintenance tab: two options

A requirement is something done to a vehicle and how often: rules (every N on a meter, every N months, a fixed date), whichever comes first; none means "when needed". Bundles are services done as one.
A · Setup holds the schedule (two sections, dialogs like meters'); the Maintenance tab shows it, with when each was last done
Wide · Setup, below Meters and Custom fields (Maintainer mode)
On a fixed date · next 30 Nov 2026
Remove: only one no task has done (turn it off instead); it leaves its bundles too.
Viewers and Drivers see the same lists without the buttons.
Wide · Add or edit a requirement (a dialog)
Due by the end of the month
No rules: done when needed. A fixed date asks for the
first due date (optional); each job gives the next.
On a fixed date · next 30 Nov 2026
5,000-mile service: Engine oil & filter, Rotate tires
On a fixed date · next 30 Nov
Copy from… (both options): a dialog, on a vehicle with no schedule yet
4 requirements and 1 bundle. Copies, never links.
Left out (no matching meter on Van):
Meter rules move to the meter with the same name and
kind; the rest of each requirement still copies.
Only offered while the vehicle has no requirements.
+ Setup stays the one place things are set up (like
meters and fields); nothing to learn.
+ The Maintenance tab is calm and read-only: what's
tracked and when it was last done.
− Changing the schedule means going to Setup.
B · The Maintenance tab is the schedule: a table to read, with editing in place for Maintainers; a requirement opens as its own page
Setup's section just says: "The schedule is on the Maintenance tab."
Phone · editing one, as a page
Phone · a vehicle with no schedule
Copy is offered right where the
+ One place to see and change the schedule; Maintainers edit where they read.
+ The table compares requirements at a glance (wide screens).
+ The empty state offers Copy right away.
− A table needs reflowing on phones (cards there anyway).
− Setup no longer holds everything about setting a vehicle up.
− The "sentence" rule editor is more work and harder with three rules.
Both: names in the household's words ("Issues"); Viewers and Drivers see the schedule,
only Maintainers (in Maintainer or Admin mode) change it. A bundle's dialog is a name
and a checklist of the vehicle's requirements, in order. Mixing is fine.
